jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Frontend - Consumer
jobs.description:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

The Consumer team owns the Kraken app experience used by millions of traders and crypto newcomers worldwide, the product that turns someone's first crypto curiosity into a long-term relationship with Kraken. We build the interfaces people actually use to buy, sell, manage their portfolio, and interact with their assets. Our stack is React on web and React Native on mobile, and we ship fast, measure everything, and iterate based on real user behaviour. We work agile, globally distributed, and we care as much about why we build something as how we build it.

We're looking for a world-class Senior Frontend Engineer to join our product-minded engineering team: we care about customer problems, measurable outcomes, frontend craft, and fast iteration. We work across web and mobile surfaces, partner closely with Product, Design, Data, and Platform teams, and use experimentation, observability, and user behaviour to guide what we build next.

The opportunity

- Design, develop, and maintain high-quality consumer-facing features across web (React) and mobile (React Native), owning the full experience from concept to production monitoring.
- Own the full lifecycle of product work, from discovery and technical design through release, monitoring, experimentation, and iteration.
- Drive A/B testing and experimentation strategies forming hypotheses, designing experiments, analysing results, and iterating based on data.
- Partner with Product, Design, Data, and Mobile engineers to create coherent experiences across Kraken’s consumer surfaces.
- Make opinionated technical decisions on framework and architecture choices (we want engineers who have strong views on things like TanStack Router vs Next.js App Router and can back them up with real experience).
- Set the standard for high-quality code — functional correctness, accessibility, performance, and testability are non-negotiables.
- Mentor engineers across seniority levels and contribute to a culture of craft and continuous improvement.
- Lead and collaborate on complex cross-platform initiatives, driving alignment across web and mobile surfaces.
- Stay ahead of the curve on React ecosystem tooling, React Server Components, concurrent features, streaming, and bring those insights back to the team.
- Work AI-natively, we use AI tools across the full SDLC and expect engineers to have a structured, opinionated workflow, not just autocomplete.

What You Bring

- 6+ years of professional software development experience with a strong focus on consumer-facing web and/or mobile products.
- Deep expertise in TypeScript and the React ecosystem, you have opinions about state management, data fetching patterns, and component architecture, and you can articulate the trade-offs.
- Production experience with React Native and cross-platform mobile development, including App Store and Google Play release pipelines.
- Experience with Next.js — specifically familiarity with App Router, React Server Components, and the client/server boundary decisions that come with them.
- Hands-on experience with A/B testing, feature flags, and experimentation frameworks (LaunchDarkly, Optimizely, or similar).
- Experience with WebSockets or Server-Sent Events for real-time UI updates.
- Strong testing culture Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright or Cypress, and the judgement to know when to use each.
- Familiarity with modern build tooling (Vite, Webpack, CI/CD pipelines) and performance profiling.
- Experience in fintech, crypto, payments, or other high-trust consumer products where correctness and user confidence matter.
- Strong written and verbal English, you can write a clear RFC, give direct feedback in a PR review, and explain a technical trade-off to a non-technical stakeholder.
- An active AI-assisted development workflow, Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, or equivalent with the engineering rigour to review and own what gets produced.

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

Role: DevOps Principal Engineer – Tech Lead

Location: Katowice / Wrocław - hybrid

Role Overview

The DevOps Principal Engineer – Tech Lead provides senior technical leadership across cloud engineering, automation, and DevOps practices. The role blends hands-on engineering excellence with leadership responsibility to deliver scalable, secure, and resilient DevOps solutions across global, multi-region environments.

The Principal Engineer collaborates with architects, product owners, QA, Security, and global engineering teams to define standards, guide solution design, and mature DevOps capabilities across the program.

Key Responsibilities

- Technology Leadership & Solution Design
- Architect and implement DevOps solutions including CI/CD, containerization, IaC, and cloud‑native designs in Azure.
- Design multi‑stage CI/CD pipelines for complex applications with automation‑first, zero‑touch principles.
- Lead Helm chart design, Kubernetes manifests, and release templates for enterprise deployments.
- Drive AKS strategy: lifecycle, security, networking, scaling, and multi‑region resiliency.
- Ensure alignment with EY reference architectures, governance, and security controls.
- Evaluate and select DevOps and automation tooling to improve reliability and delivery velocity.
- Lead modernization from classic/legacy pipelines to YAML and GitHub Actions.
- Delivery Oversight & Engineering Excellence
- Oversee backlog execution, ensuring automated build, test, and deployment processes.
- Drive consistent delivery of DevOps capabilities aligned to defined standards.
- Lead configuration management and environment alignment for multi‑region deployments.
- Lead troubleshooting and root‑cause analysis of complex deployment or automation incidents.
- Advance DevOps maturity through measurable improvements in delivery and reliability metrics.
- Governance, Standards & Best Practices
- Promote automation‑first, GitOps, secure SDLC, YAML pipelines, and shift‑left.
- Implement mandatory scanning, secrets management, dependency governance, and hardening.
- Define standards for branching, versioning, Helm packaging, release governance, and promotions.
- Ensure compliance with EY security requirements using SonarQube, AquaSec, Mend.
- Establish RBAC, audit trails, and governance across Azure, AKS, and CI/CD.
- Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement
- Serve as senior DevOps authority for architecture, cybersecurity, QA, and product teams.
- Drive cross‑team decision‑making with clear communication and proactive risk escalation.
- Work with engineering leads to embed DevOps practices and self‑service capabilities.
- Documentation & Team Development
- Maintain high‑quality documentation across architecture, CI/CD, runbooks, and dependencies.
- Mentor engineers and promote DevOps maturity across the organization.
- Deliver training on CI/CD, Kubernetes, automation, and DevOps best practices.

Must‑Have Skills & Experience

Cloud & Infrastructure (Azure) – Expert

- 5–10 years hands‑on Azure experience.
- Deep AKS expertise including cluster design, networking, security, RBAC, multi‑region deployments.
- Strong knowledge of Azure Networking, App Gateway/WAF, App Service, Functions, Logic Apps, Storage, Azure SQL, Traffic Manager, Key Vault, Service Bus, Monitoring suite.

DevOps, CI/CD & Automation – Expert

- GitHub / ADO: branching, YAML pipelines, release governance.
- Advanced CI/CD design including platform migrations.
- Docker and multi‑stage Dockerfiles; image optimization.
- Helm expertise (required).
- Terraform or Bicep (preferred); ARM templates.
- Ansible/Ansible Tower (plus).

Kubernetes & Orchestration – Expert

- Deployments, ingress, config maps, secrets, RBAC, network policies.
- HPA/VPA scaling; GitOps tooling (Flux/ArgoCD) preferred.
- Helm Charts expertise (required).

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Construction Engineer (Poland)
jobs.description:
Inżynier budownictwa ds. wdrożeń u klienta (K/M)

Part-time to start

- Remote, Poland (onboarding in Stockholm)
- Construction × AI

Fluent English is required for this role: it’s our working language across the company. Wersja polska na końcu dokumentu.

About Brickanta

Brickanta is the AI-native agentic platform for construction. Hundreds of AI agents take on the administrative heavy lifting across bidding, procurement, compliance and quality assurance, so builders finish projects on time and on budget.

We’re backed by Y Combinator, have raised over $8M from Northzone, Anton Osika and Mario Götze, and already work with some of the largest contractors and developers in the industry. We’re an early team and growing fast, operating like an elite sports team: maximum freedom paired with maximum responsibility. You own your work, you document what matters, and you win and lose as a team.

Having built the platform with builders in the Nordics, we’re now taking it across Europe. Poland is one of our first markets, and this is one of our first roles on the ground.

The role

Most enterprise AI dies in the proof of concept. Forward deployed engineering is how we avoid that: you sit inside the customer’s workflow — on site, in the bid room, in the procurement process — and build until the work actually gets done differently.

In a new market, that also means teaching our agents how construction works here. An answer can look plausible and still be wrong in the way that matters on a real project: a FIDIC contract clause read the wrong way, a bill of quantities (przedmiar) that doesn’t match the cost estimate, a requirement in the tender specification (SWZ) that gets missed. Your job is to spot that and turn the judgment into evals our systems can measure.

This is not consulting and it is not a demo role. You ship product: take a real bottleneck at a real contractor, build the agent workflow that removes it, prove the outcome in numbers, and bring what you learned back into the core platform.

What you’ll own

Deployments

Own named accounts in Poland end to end: understand the workflow, configure and extend our agents against their real documents and data, and get them into daily use.

Evaluation and ground truth

Run our agents against real Polish workflows and judge the outputs on correctness, completeness and practical usefulness, not on whether they sound convincing. Turn edge cases and production failures into repeatable evals: reference outputs, scoring rubrics, failure taxonomies and expert-reviewed datasets.

Building in the field

Write code. Integrations, data pipelines, prompts, eval harnesses, automated graders and occasionally a whole new feature: whatever it takes to make the workflow work at that customer. Work out what needs human judgment, then engineer the rest away.

Measurable outcomes

Define what success means before you start, then prove it: hours saved, bids won, risks caught. Measurable results rather than technical milestones.

Feeding the product

Capture what only shows up in production here, from SWZ documents and przedmiary to how tendering and procurement really run, and turn it into datasets, reusable building blocks and roadmap. Each deployment in Poland should make the next one faster.

Who we’re looking for

Some combination of construction depth, technical depth and a liking for customers. The unusual profile matters more than the perfect CV.

Background

- Real exposure to construction in Poland: site work, site or works management, cost estimating (kosztorysowanie), tenders, procurement or quality control.
- Experience building and shipping software (Python and/or TypeScript, APIs, data pipelines, SQL), or the raw ingredients and the drive to get there quickly.
- Strong analytical ability and a serious interest in modern AI systems. We operate as an AI-first company.
- Experience working directly with customers, or a clear appetite for it.
- Fluent English, since it’s our working language, and native Polish. No Swedish needed.

Mindset

- You go to where the work happens — site visits, bid rooms, procurement meetings — instead of guessing from a backlog.
- Extremely detail-oriented: you work through many cases without letting the quality bar drift.
- Curious about why systems fail, not just whether they fail.
- High ownership: you find the problem, build the fix and follow it into production.
- You write clearly. At Brickanta, writing creates clarity and everything important gets documented, which matters even more when the team is in another country.
- Comfortable with ambiguity and with being the only engineer in the room.

Growth path

This seat is built to grow with the Polish market. You join part-time about three months into our launch in Poland, as the first customers go live, with the aim of going full-time as the market grows. From there the role grows with it: running the first deployments yourself, then hiring and leading a forward deployed team in Poland, and over time owning Brickanta’s technical presence in the country alongside our local commercial lead.

Few people get to build and scale an AI company in a new market from the start, with a funded product and team behind them. That is the opportunity here: take Poland from first pilots to its leading contractors and developers, with responsibility, compensation and equity that grow as the market does. If you would rather go deep than broad, the path also runs inward to core AI, evals and platform engineering.

Snapshot

Location

Remote in Poland, with regular time on site at customers. You start with onboarding at our HQ in Stockholm alongside the team, then come back regularly. Travel and accommodation are covered.

Start

First half of 2027, about three months into our launch in Poland. Part-time to start (or a similar flexible setup), with the aim of going full-time as the market grows.

Level

Mid to senior. We care more about what you’ve built, on site or in code, than about years.

Comp

Competitive salary and equity — you’re early enough for it to matter.

Inżynier budownictwa ds. wdrożeń u klienta (K/M)

Niepełny etat

- Zdalnie z Polski (onboarding w Sztokholmie)
- Budownictwo × AI

To polska wersja ogłoszenia. Angielski jest w tej roli niezbędny, bo to nasz język roboczy w całej firmie.

O firmie Brickanta

Brickanta to agentowa platforma AI-native dla budownictwa. Setki agentów AI przejmują najcięższą część pracy administracyjnej przy ofertowaniu, zakupach, zgodności z przepisami i zapewnianiu jakości, dzięki czemu firmy budowlane kończą projekty na czas i w budżecie.

Wspiera nas Y Combinator, pozyskaliśmy ponad 8 mln USD od Northzone, Antona Osiki i Mario Götzego, a już dziś pracujemy z jednymi z największych wykonawców i deweloperów w branży. Jesteśmy młodym, szybko rosnącym zespołem i działamy jak drużyna sportowa na najwyższym poziomie: maksimum swobody i maksimum odpowiedzialności. Każdy odpowiada za swoją pracę, dokumentuje to, co ważne, a wygrywamy i przegrywamy jako zespół.

Po zbudowaniu platformy razem z firmami budowlanymi w krajach nordyckich wprowadzamy ją teraz w całej Europie. Polska jest jednym z naszych pierwszych rynków, a to jedno z pierwszych stanowisk, które obsadzamy na miejscu.

Rola

Większość korporacyjnych projektów AI umiera na etapie proof of concept. Forward deployed engineering to nasz sposób, żeby tego uniknąć: pracujesz w samym środku procesów klienta – na budowie, w dziale ofertowania, w procesie zakupowym – i budujesz, dopóki praca naprawdę nie zacznie wyglądać inaczej.

Na nowym rynku oznacza to też uczenie naszych agentów, jak się buduje tutaj. Odpowiedź może wyglądać wiarygodnie, a mimo to być błędna dokładnie tam, gdzie ma to znaczenie w prawdziwym projekcie: źle odczytana klauzula kontraktu FIDIC, przedmiar, który nie zgadza się z kosztorysem, pominięty wymóg z SWZ. Twoim zadaniem jest to wychwycić i zamienić tę ocenę w ewaluacje (evals), które nasze systemy potrafią mierzyć.

To nie jest doradztwo ani rola od demo. Dostarczasz produkt: bierzesz realne wąskie gardło w realnej firmie budowlanej, budujesz przepływ pracy agentów, który je usuwa, udowadniasz efekt liczbami i przenosisz zdobytą wiedzę z powrotem do platformy.

Za co odpowiadasz

Wdrożenia

Odpowiadasz za konkretnych klientów w Polsce od początku do końca: rozumiesz ich procesy, konfigurujesz i rozwijasz naszych agentów na ich prawdziwych dokumentach i danych, i sprawiasz, że korzystają z nich na co dzień.

Ewaluacja i dane referencyjne

Testujesz naszych agentów na prawdziwych polskich procesach i oceniasz wyniki pod kątem poprawności, kompletności i praktycznej użyteczności, a nie tego, jak przekonująco brzmią. Przypadki brzegowe i błędy z realnego użycia zamieniasz w powtarzalne evale: odpowiedzi wzorcowe, kryteria oceny, taksonomie błędów i zbiory danych zweryfikowane przez ekspertów.

Budowanie w terenie

Piszesz kod. Integracje, pipeline’y danych, prompty, środowiska ewaluacyjne, automatyczne systemy oceny, a czasem zupełnie nową funkcję – wszystko, czego trzeba, żeby proces działał u danego klienta. Rozumiesz, co wymaga ludzkiej oceny, a resztę automatyzujesz.

Mierzalne efekty

Zanim zaczniesz, definiujesz, czym jest sukces, a potem go udowadniasz: zaoszczędzone godziny, wygrane przetargi, wychwycone ryzyka. Mierzalne wyniki zamiast technicznych kamieni milowych.

Wiedza z powrotem do produktu

Zbierasz to, co wychodzi dopiero w realnym użyciu tutaj, od SWZ i przedmiarów po to, jak naprawdę wyglądają przetargi i zakupy, i zamieniasz to w zbiory danych, komponenty wielokrotnego użytku i roadmapę. Każde wdrożenie w Polsce powinno przyspieszać kolejne.

Kogo szukamy

Szukamy połączenia znajomości budownictwa, głębi technicznej i chęci do pracy z klientami. Nietypowy profil liczy się bardziej niż idealne CV.

Doświadczenie

- Realne doświadczenie w budownictwie w Polsce: praca na budowie, kierowanie budową lub robotami, kosztorysowanie, przetargi, zakupy albo kontrola jakości.
- Doświadczenie w tworzeniu i wdrażaniu oprogramowania (Python i/lub TypeScript, API, pipeline’y danych, SQL) albo solidne podstawy i determinacja, żeby szybko tam dojść.
- Silne zdolności analityczne i poważne zainteresowanie nowoczesnymi systemami AI. Działamy jako firma AI-first.
- Doświadczenie w bezpośredniej pracy z klientami albo wyraźna chęć do niej.
- Biegły angielski, bo to nasz język roboczy, i polski na poziomie natywnym. Szwedzki nie jest potrzebny.

Nastawienie

- Idziesz tam, gdzie dzieje się praca – wizyty na budowie, dział ofert, spotkania zakupowe – zamiast zgadywać na podstawie backlogu.
- Ogromna dbałość o szczegóły: przerabiasz wiele przypadków, nie obniżając poprzeczki jakości.
- Ciekawość, dlaczego systemy zawodzą, a nie tylko czy zawodzą.
- Wysokie poczucie odpowiedzialności: znajdujesz problem, budujesz rozwiązanie i doprowadzasz je do produkcji.
- Piszesz jasno. W firmie Brickanta pisanie porządkuje myślenie, a wszystko, co ważne, jest dokumentowane, co ma jeszcze większe znaczenie, gdy zespół jest w innym kraju.
- Dobrze odnajdujesz się w niejasnych sytuacjach i jako jedyna osoba techniczna w pokoju.

Ścieżka rozwoju

To stanowisko jest pomyślane tak, żeby rosło razem z polskim rynkiem. Dołączasz na niepełny etat mniej więcej trzy miesiące po starcie naszego wejścia do Polski, gdy pierwsi klienci zaczynają korzystać z platformy, z myślą o przejściu na pełny etat, gdy rynek urośnie. Od tego momentu rola rozwija się razem z nim: najpierw osobiście prowadzisz pierwsze wdrożenia, potem rekrutujesz i prowadzisz polski zespół forward deployed, a z czasem odpowiadasz za techniczną obecność firmy Brickanta w kraju, razem z naszym lokalnym liderem sprzedaży.

Niewielu osobom trafia się okazja, by od początku budować i skalować firmę AI na nowym rynku, z finansowanym produktem i zespołem za plecami. Na tym polega ta szansa: przeprowadzić Polskę od pierwszych pilotaży do największych wykonawców i deweloperów w kraju, z odpowiedzialnością, wynagrodzeniem i udziałami, które rosną razem z rynkiem. Jeśli wolisz iść w głąb niż wszerz, ścieżka prowadzi też do rdzenia produktu: core AI, ewaluacji i inżynierii platformy.

W skrócie

Lokalizacja

Praca zdalna w Polsce, z regularnym czasem na budowach u klientów. Zaczynasz od onboardingu w naszej centrali w Sztokholmie razem z zespołem, a potem regularnie tam wracasz. Podróż i zakwaterowanie pokrywamy my.

Start

Pierwsza połowa 2027 roku, około trzech miesięcy po starcie w Polsce. Na początek niepełny etat (lub podobna elastyczna forma), z myślą o przejściu na pełny etat, gdy rynek urośnie.

Poziom

Mid lub senior. Bardziej niż lata doświadczenia liczy się to, co masz na koncie, na budowie albo w kodzie.

Wynagrodzenie

Konkurencyjne wynagrodzenie i udziały (equity) – dołączasz na tyle wcześnie, że to ma znaczenie.

jobs.description:
About Sezzle{{{{~}}}}

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

Interview Process

We believe transparency is important at Sezzle. Regularly providing feedback while setting expectations is part of our culture starting with the interview process. Advancement through each step is not guaranteed.

- Application submitted (you are here)
- Wonderlic test (30-40 min)
- Coding assessment ({{{{~}}}}1.5 hours)
- Interview with recruiters (30 min)
- Interview with engineers (1 hour)
- Interview with engineering leadership (30-45 min)
- Offer!

About the Role{{{{~}}}}

We are seeking a talented and motivated Software Engineer II who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement. As a Software Engineer II, you will be responsible for solving our most challenging problems along with a highly-motivated team. In this role, you will work closely with other engineers across multiple teams to provide high-quality, scalable, and innovative products.

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include partnering with other engineers to design, develop, and deliver new features. As your skills grow so will the size and scope of the projects which you’ll be involved in. Sezzle has a strong culture for promotion with defined paths through Engineering that matches all levels. You’ll be working as part of a full-stack Engineering team which has varied disciplines.

Key Role Responsibilities{{{{~}}}}

- Build and maintain new innovative product features focused on actively learning new areas of the product
- Collaborate with owners for different product features to gain insight and offer constructive suggestions for improvements
- Be an active participant in design/architecture discussions sharing your ideas while building the next generation of features for the Sezzle platform
- Hands-on with our codebase and a contributor to code reviews
- Mentor other engineers who are starting along their career path
- Work with the team to continuously build and deploy scalable solutions
- Assist in planning, estimations, and completion for projects brought up by the team stakeholders

Minimum Requirements{{{{~}}}}

- Experience solving technical problems as part of a team
- Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
- Familiarity with modern Frontend Development, with React experience preferred
- Ability to solve problems with backend-focused languages like Go or similar compiled statically typed language
- Intermediate understanding of relational databases like MySQL

Preferred Knowledge and Skills{{{{~}}}}

- Knowledgeable in writing automated tests for applications (unit, integration, end-to-end)
- Familiar with the basic principles and design of RESTful APIs
- Basic knowledge of a Microservice Architecture
- Close familiarity with software engineering tools, software development methodology, and release processes

About You{{{{~}}}}

- You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
- You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
- You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
- You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
- You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
- You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

Sezzle’s Technology Stack{{{{~}}}}

- Languages{{{{~}}}} Golang, Typescript, Python
- Frontend{{{{~}}}} Typescript - React and React Native
- Backend{{{{~}}}} Golang
- Database{{{{~}}}} MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
- DevOps & Cloud{{{{~}}}} AWS, Kubernetes
- Version Control{{{{~}}}} Git
- CI/CD{{{{~}}}} Gitlab
- Testing{{{{~}}}} Developer-driven, focus on automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests
- Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

#Full-time
